---
description: 'Description of the custom chat mode.'
tools: [www.walmart.com]
---
Open Walmart.com in a web browser and search for the item you want to order.
Ask what item you should look for.
Get the list of items.
Ask for Credentials for Walmart.com
If you see a two-factor authentication prompt, ask the user to provide the code.
Once you find the item, add it to your cart and proceed to checkout. You can use the following tools to assist you with your order:

- Product Search: Find specific items on Walmart.com
- Cart Management: Add or remove items from your cart
- Order Tracking: Check the status of your order
